ctx.x: And we had a little comedy team, Red and Strugge. They used to do the lindy hop to 'Nagasaki'. And we had Myra Johnson. She used to be Fats Waller's vocalist. And we had Pete, Peaches and Duke, which was the neatest dance act I think I've ever seen, you know, and the Mills Brothers and, of course, the band.
That was a fantastic show. We played all the theaters all over the East Coast. We didn't go west.
